gitCommit.subject: Fix dead post-checkout sync and ends_at billing-date mislabel
gitCommit.body:
Fix dead post-checkout sync and ends_at billing-date mislabel

Two subscription bugs found while diagnosing a Stripe webhook outage.

1. The post-checkout fallback sync had never run. success_url lacked the
   literal {CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID} placeholder, so stripe_checkout_session_id
   was always blank and sync_subscription_from_stripe_session returned
   immediately. The webhook was the only path from payment to access on both
   web and Android; a missed webhook meant a charged user with no premium.
   iOS is unaffected — it hides checkout entirely for Apple's IAP rules.

   The placeholder is appended as a raw string: through a url helper Rails
   percent-encodes the braces and Stripe leaves them unsubstituted.

2. "Next billing" read ends_at, which Pay populates only on cancellation
   (canceled? is literally ends_at?). The line therefore rendered only for
   subscriptions that would never be billed again, and never for an actual
   subscriber. Now reads current_period_end, with a separate cancels_on
   message for scheduled cancellations.

Also throttles /checkout/success, which is public and now issues an
outbound Stripe call, matching the existing checkout-endpoint throttles.

Specs were watched fail first, including the Playwright ones — reverting
the controller turns both red for the right reasons. Two dedicated seed
users cover the renewing and cancelled states; making the shared e2e user
premium would lift the free-tier gates other specs depend on.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
